literal: All the world that lives looking towards the sky, the subjects live looking towards the king's sceptre.
translation: Just as all living beings in the world look up to the sky for rain to survive, so do subjects look up to the righteous sceptre of their king for their livelihood.
modern: மழைக்காக வானத்தை எதிர்பார்த்து உலகத்து உயிர்கள் எல்லாம் வாழ்கின்றன; அதுபோல, அரசனது செங்கோலை எதிர்பார்த்து அவனுடைய குடிமக்கள் வாழ்கின்றனர்.
explanation: This couplet compares the dependence of the world on rain to the dependence of citizens on a just ruler. The word 'வான்' refers to the sky, representing the rain that sustains all life on earth. 'கோல்' refers to the sceptre, symbolizing the king's righteous and just rule. Just as crops and living beings cannot survive without timely rain from the heavens, citizens cannot thrive or live in peace without the protective and fair governance of their ruler. The parallel structure of 'வானோக்கி வாழும்' and 'கோல் நோக்கி வாழும்' beautifully highlights this vital relationship.
